summary: Brandon Pho / Mission Local: A profile of Mariano-Florentino Cuéllar, Anthropic's first global affairs chief, who had helped shape California's first AI safety law in 2025 — In a hot and dry border town at the base of California's Imperial Valley, the list of powerful alumni at Calexico High School is short.
